title: Decentralized Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Predictive Shielding
abstract: arXiv:2609.07618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Environments are increasingly populated by multiple robots performing independent tasks with limited prior knowledge of each other. Deploying such multi-agent systems presents significant challenges. Specifically, shifts in deployment states compared to training data can lead to poor policy performance and compromised safety. While safety shields exist to mitigate these risks, they are typically reactive, which degrades performance near unseen obstacles,and centralized, limiting their scalability. To address this, we propose a decentralized framework that integrates predictive shielding with model-based finite horizon Q-learning. This approach allows agents to safely adapt their pre-trained policies during deployment. Furthermore, to mitigate livelocks in symmetric scenarios, we introduce a communication- free protocol for conflict resolution

translated_title: 基于预测屏蔽的去中心化安全多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 环境中越来越多地出现多个执行独立任务且彼此先验知识有限的机器人。部署此类多智能体系统面临重大挑战。具体而言，与训练数据相比，部署时状态的变化可能导致策略性能不佳和安全性受损。虽然现有的安全屏蔽机制可以缓解这些风险，但它们通常是反应式的，这会在未见过的障碍物附近降低性能，并且是中心化的，限制了其可扩展性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个将预测屏蔽与基于模型的有限时域Q学习相结合的去中心化框架。这种方法使智能体能够在部署期间安全地调整其预训练策略。此外，为了缓解对称场景中的活锁问题，我们引入了一种无需通信的冲突解决协议。
tldr: 提出了一种将预测屏蔽与基于模型的有限时域Q学习相结合的去中心化安全框架，使智能体能在部署时安全调整预训练策略，并通过无需通信的冲突解决协议缓解对称场景中的活锁问题。
en_tdlr: We propose a decentralized safe framework integrating predictive shielding with model-based finite horizon Q-learning, enabling agents to safely adapt pre-trained policies during deployment, with a communication-free conflict resolution protocol to mitigate livelocks in symmetric scenarios.
